learning_objective: 🎯 Discover how to use colorful drawings and illustrations to tell your favorite stories and sing-along songs!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we listen to a beautiful story or song, pictures pop into our heads! Illustrating means catching those pictures and drawing them on paper.
Every story has a hero, an animal, or a funny character. We can use shapes and bright colors to bring these characters to life!
Where does your story happen? Is it a dark forest or a sunny beach? Drawing the background helps people see exactly where the adventure takes place.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Favorite Song Scene!
fun_activity.instructions: Sing your favorite nursery rhyme or song. Pick the best part of the song and draw a big, colorful picture showing exactly what is happening!

quick_recap: ⭐ Illustrations are pictures that help tell a story or match a song.
⭐ Drawing funny or brave characters makes our stories exciting.
⭐ A good background sets the perfect scene for our story's adventure.
